entities.title: The GDD and RULES still state things later decisions changed
entities.summary: GDD §6 still offers reports several times a month, GDD §10 and §12 promise no account and an offline page, and RULES.md's status line still waits for the owner's approval.
entities.expected: The documents agree with the decisions they record and with the code: one report offer a month (RULES §4 step 15); the page needs a sign-in to icelander.net, so it is not usable signed out or offline before it loads; RULES.md approved (GDD §14: approved on merge).
entities.observed: GDD §6, Core loop, step 8: the intelligence reports are "offered several times a month". GDD §10: "no account, no cookies" and a page that "keeps working offline once loaded"; GDD §12: "No accounts". RULES.md: "owner approval: _pending_".
acceptanceCriteria: GDD §6, §10 and §12 match the decision log in GDD §14 and worker/index.ts's sign-in.
RULES.md's status line records the approval.

origin.description: Found while reading the design documents against the code for the .dev files.
